title: Pointer to the properties of [def-pur-td-datum]
text:
In the notation of [def-pur-td-datum], the following holds. The
ambient exceptional right
adjoint datum of [def-weil-ambient-exceptional-adjoint] is not assumed,
the adjoint $Rf^{\times}$ occurring below on the coefficients of this
chapter being the theorem [cor-sf-ambient-adjoint-discharge] there.
